github-actions.description: Example workflows that live outside .github/workflows. Patterns add to the manager's defaults, which only see .github/workflows and action.yml.

flux.description: HelmRelease charts, OCIRepository and GitRepository tags in the Flux examples. The flux manager's default only matches gotk-components.yaml.

kubernetes.description: Manifests with real, public images. The kubernetes manager matches nothing by default; the other example manifests use placeholder registries. Do not add HelmRelease files: the flux manager already extracts images from their values, and a second extraction opens a duplicate PR (#225 next to #226).

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions - pin to commit SHA for security
Terraform providers - minor/patch, merged by renovate-gate
Helm charts - patch only, merged by renovate-gate
Stable patch updates - merged by renovate-gate
Go modules — minor/patch, merged by renovate-gate
npm packages — minor/patch, merged by renovate-gate

Hold TypeScript on 6.x. TypeScript 7 removed the 'baseUrl' compiler option, and @docusaurus/tsconfig 3.10.x still sets it, so 'npm run typecheck' fails with TS5102 on any 7.x. The option is inherited from the package, so it cannot be overridden locally. Lift this cap once Docusaurus ships a tsconfig without baseUrl.
Python packages — minor/patch, merged by renovate-gate

setup-terraform's terraform_version is already extracted by the terraform_version custom manager below as hashicorp/terraform, which also covers composite-action inputs and gh-aw sources. Extracting it here too opened a second PR for the same line.
The Kubescape CLI in CI and the operator's scanner image override must move together; the operator HelmRelease says so.
The loadtester chart is released with Flagger; bump them together.
A gh-aw workflow source does not take effect until it is recompiled, and the compiled lock fails its stale-lock check meanwhile.
prBodyNotes: :warning: This updates a gh-aw workflow source. Run `gh aw compile <workflow> --strict` and commit the regenerated `.lock.yml` to this branch before merging; the workflow fails its stale-lock check until then.

customManagers.description: Update Terraform version in GitHub Actions workflows and gh-aw workflow sources (.md frontmatter)

Annotated pins: a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above a `KEY: value` line. Covers tool versions in env blocks and action inputs that no built-in manager reads. An optional `*_SHA256` line directly below is captured as the digest, so github-release-attachments updates the checksum with the version. tests/renovate-coverage.sh fails on an unannotated pin.
